final_resume.summary: Computer Science graduate (B.Tech 2025) seeking a Software Development Engineer role. Proficient in full-stack development with Java, Spring Boot, and React; demonstrates strong problem-solving and attention to detail in building scalable backend services and responsive frontends.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks for created, captured and refunded states. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the app with Docker, ensuring robust error handling and payment state management.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Designed a Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms. Piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students, eliminating double bookings through transactional consistency.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status. Containerised with Docker Compose for local development and deployment.

profile_improvement_tips: Study and implement Data Structures (linked lists, trees, graphs, heaps) and Algorithms (sorting, searching, dynamic programming) in a portfolio project or LeetCode-style problem set to demonstrate core CS fundamentals.
Build a project that showcases Distributed Systems concepts: implement a multi-service architecture using microservices, message queues (RabbitMQ or Kafka), or eventual consistency patterns.
Deepen Object-Oriented Design skills by refactoring existing projects to use design patterns (Factory, Observer, Strategy) and document the architectural decisions in a README or blog post.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong full-stack developer with solid project experience, but the JD emphasizes core CS fundamentals (Data Structures, Algorithms, Distributed Systems, Object-Oriented Design) that are not yet evident in your profile. Gaining hands-on experience in these areas will significantly strengthen your candidacy for this role.
